programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the ultimate adventure as KREW heads to Japan! This jam-packed vlog follows the team as they explore the Cup Noodle Museum in Yokohama, customize their own ramen, and visit a life-size Gundam. From feeding polite deer in Nara Park to meeting mischievous squirrel monkeys in Ishigaki, every moment is filled with laughter and discovery. It’s a colorful journey of food, culture, and fun!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the highs and lows of the wild as KREW takes on their first-ever camping trip. From battling swarms of mosquitoes and struggling to set up a lopsided tent to cooking "unesthetic" breakfast beans and campfire sausages, this vlog captures it all. Watch the fun unfold as they navigate the realities of survival, share laughs, and ultimately learn that camping isn't always like the movies.

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience Singapore with KREW as they visit the Jewel at Changi Airport to see the world's tallest indoor waterfall. From a daring 10-minute airport haircut challenge to taste-testing 7-Eleven dim sum and "serious" popcorn, the fun never stops. Watch them explore the Sensory Odyssey exhibit, create digital sea creatures, and brave a nearly empty Halloween Horror Nights at Universal Studios.

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the magic of KREW’s winter adventures! From building a "Diva Snowman" in the freezing cold to braving the heights of the Capilano Suspension Bridge at night, this episode is packed with holiday cheer. Watch the gang take on a chaotic gingerbread build-off, explore a festive Christmas Market via sea bus, and exchange hilarious secret Santa gifts. A perfect KREWmas celebration!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: KREW sets sail for an unforgettable fishing adventure! After stocking up on gourmet ingredients, the crew hits the ocean to catch their own dinner. Watch as they battle the waves, reel in rockfish and flounder, and haul in a massive catch of crabs. The excitement continues back in the kitchen as they try to cook their fresh bounty. Will their culinary skills match their fishing luck?

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the ultimate adventure as the KREW travels to Macau! From tasting the #1 bestselling jerky and fluffy mango mochi to exploring the historic Ruins of St. Paul's, the group dives deep into local culture. Watch their first-ever meet and greet in Asia, an emotional fan mail unboxing, and a fun martial arts challenge. Of course, no trip is complete without trying world-famous egg tarts!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Travel with KREW to Bana Hills, a stunning amusement park in the sky! Watch as they brave the world's longest cable car ride, attempt a spinning dropper, and navigate a tricky maze garden. Between reapplying sunscreen and laughing through carnival games, the crew explores medieval sights and the iconic Golden Bridge. Experience the heights and hilarious moments of their high-altitude adventure!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience a Wild West adventure with KREW in Canmore, Alberta! Watch as they explore a historic mountain town, go horseback riding through scenic trails, and compete in a sharpshooter challenge. From tasting real maple syrup on snow to trying weird deep-fried carnival treats, this vlog is packed with fun. Will they find gold or just "fool's gold"? Find out in this action-packed western journey!

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.desc: The Kennedy Center puts Trump’s name up in lights, Karoline Leavitt gives her final bow, and ICE’s electric gloves steal the show. This week, Congressman Ted Lieu and David Pakman debate an AI Kill Switch and consider algorithmic clickbait. Jim Rash pays respects to Allison Janney, Barbie 2, and Woke 1.0. We spin the Rant Wheel on Captcha, tipping, AI writing ticks, and singing Happy Birthday. And we snuggle in for the night with a cozy round of Second Thoughts.

programme.title: Offline with Jon Favreau
programme.desc: Can the internet foster productive debate in the rage-bait era? Jubilee founder and CEO Jason Y. Lee joins Offline to talk about his company’s massive YouTube channel, known for its viral political debates in series like Surrounded and Middle Ground. He and Jon talk about the moral quandary of platforming people like Charlie Kirk, what young people find so captivating about these conflict-ridden videos, and why Jason views his content as chocolate covered broccoli.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: Donald Trump hides in a catering truck and boards a secret plane to evade an Iranian security threat, leaving reporters, White House officials, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio alone aboard Air Force One to fend for themselves. Dan and Jon discuss the President's profile in courage and the rest of the latest, including a series of shocking new developments with ICE, the discourse around electability after David Crowley's unexpected primary win in Wisconsin, and Nate Silver's new midterm model, which is uncharacteristically optimistic about Democrats' chances of taking back both the House and Senate. Then, the guys bid farewell to press secretary Karoline Leavitt and debate which MAGA-world figures are most likely to replace her.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc:
Donald Trump’s poll numbers are trash — and numbers for right-wing influencers on YouTube, Twitter and elsewhere are going down the tubes, too. As the New York Times reported at the end of last month, some of the biggest names in right-wing media are experiencing massive declines in clicks and views to their content. David Pakman is the host of the David Pakman Show on YouTube – and he’s been thinking a lot about the algorithms that control what we watch, read, listen to and think about. He stopped by to talk about how right-wing media has become a victim of its own success.
And in headlines, Karoline Leavitt is leaving the White House at the end of the month to spend more time with her family, U.S. inflation declined slightly last month and what’s behind Zohran Mamdani’s approval rating after eight months in office.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc:
The fact that the US Congress is absolutely rotten with creeps is one of the worst-kept secrets in Washington. From former Representatives like California Democrat Eric Swalwell and Texas Republican Tony Gonzales, to sitting lawmakers like North Carolina Republican Representative Chuck Edwards – it turns out sexual misconduct is bipartisan, and so is the pushback. A bipartisan effort fronted by Florida Republican Kat Cammack and New Mexico Democrat Teresa Leger Fernandez aims to rein in the frathouse behavior of their colleagues. To discuss what’s on the table, we called up Grace Panetta, political reporter with The 19th.
And in headlines, Trump blames vandals for ruining a patch of grass on the National Mall, Attorney General Todd Blanche refused to pledge that he’ll operate independently from the White House, and the Supreme Court rejected another request to throw out a jury’s 2023 finding that Trump sexually abused writer E. Jean Carroll and later defamed her.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc:
You may have heard about the conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln — the carrier where sailors have been facing food shortages and broken toilets. They’ve gone without a traditional port call for eight and a half months, and counting. But they’re not the only vessel facing long deployments and concerning conditions. In May, the USS Gerald Ford finally returned to port in the U.S. after 11 months at sea – the longest deployment since the end of the Vietnam War. Those months away from home featured a massive fire that raged for hours onboard, and – you guessed it – plumbing problems. So to talk more about what our men and women in uniform are facing because President Donald Trump started a war of choice, we spoke with Colorado Democratic Representative Jason Crow.
And in headlines, Trump delays 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian imports, the Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches 5,000 cases, and college students at some universities can now pay their tuition using PayPal or Venmo.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.desc: Donald Trump shows off his pole, Darline Graham shrugs her way to the Senate, and two Dan Sullivans (Dans Sullivan?) try to make a name for themselves. Emmy Rossum lets us in on the thrillingly intense process of making Furious. Asif Ali and Chris Olsen join us to talk setbacks, Indian weddings, and crying online. The Furious Wheel whips us into a lather, before we pull it together with a cold splash of Second Thoughts.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie uses the Angels plus his own priceless collection of jade as bait to trip up an acrobatic jewel thief and a killer in "THE JADE TRAP." Gigolo Denny Railsback murders wealthy Julie Redmond when she becomes disenchanted. As Denny is doing away with Julie in the living room, cat burglar Ted Machlin is in the bedroom stealing jewels. When Denny spots Ted, he makes it appear that the jewel thief is the murderer. The setting is a posh residential hotel into which Kelly checks as a lonely heiress, Kris as a Swedish movie star and Bosley as a flamboyant auctioneer. Sabrina does her sleuthing as a hotel employee. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie; an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David-Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Stunned by the mysterious death of his favorite folk-rock singer, Charlie sends Kelly, Kris and Sabrina to find everyone who spent time with the victim the night she pied in "Angel Blues." Amy Waters is one of the most popular singers in the country. Shortly after freaking out during a concert performance, Amy calls her dad to say she's coming home by cab to "get straight." But Amy makes a few stops along the way. One of the last people to see her alive is Lenny, the taxi driver Kris becomes acquainted with during the investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When two blonde "call girls" are brutally murdered in Mrs. Dolly Smith's apartment building, Kelly and Kris reluctantly go undercover as prostitutes and move into Mrs. Smith's establishment. On their first day at work, the trio arouses suspicion with their clever tactics to avoid meeting with "customers." But the Angels are more interested in the Italian restaurant across the street, where Freddie, the macho delivery boy works. He brings pizza to the girls in the building almost every day, and always acts aggressive and threatening. Then Bonnie, another blond girl, is attacked but manages to escape. When she says her assailant smelled like a restaurant, it looks like Freddie is the man. Freddie swears he's innocent, and when his shark's tooth pendant is found beside the latest victim, Sabrina wonders if it isn't a bit too obvious a clue. The owner of the Italian restaurant, Roman Vail, also has access to the apartment building, and the. Angels are surprised to learn that he knows Freddie lost his pendant. Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Sabrina and Kelly finally put the evidence together, they must rush to rescue blond-haired Kris who is alone in the restaurant with Vail. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. Pryor also discusses the stories and reflections behind his new book, Red Letter Days, capturing life on the road, family, and creativity through the lens of an evolving music scene.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.
